project.name: Hero: Kava Bars Stop Feeling Niche When They Become Sober Third Spaces

data.label: Style
data.name: Comic Ink + Warm Gathering
data.description: Heavy ink illustration. Bold black outlines, high contrast chiaroscuro with deep blacks and warm amber highlights. Cel-shaded shadows, graphic shapes. Warm ochre and earth tones with soft glow accents. Hand-drawn comic book aesthetic with relaxed, communal energy. Influenced by Dave McKean and Moebius. NOT photorealistic. Edge-to-edge composition.

data.label: Setting
data.description: Intimate kava bar interior with low lighting, wooden bowls, tropical plants, comfortable seating areas

data.label: Action
data.content: Warm comic-book illustration of a sober-friendly kava bar interior at dusk, people in relaxed conversation around a communal bowl and coffee cups, cozy neighborhood lounge with Birmingham, Olympia, and New Orleans influences, amber and ochre palette, heavy ink linework, chiaroscuro shadows, painterly cel shading, inviting third-space atmosphere, no visible text

data.label: Negative
data.content: photorealistic, photography, soft gradients, airbrushed, fedoras, 1940s detective imagery, film noir clichés, alcohol, beer, cocktails, drunk people, party atmosphere, bright lights, nightclub, text, watermarks, stock photo, over-rendered, plastic-looking
